sloka: तां दृष्ट्वा घोरसङ्काशां शक्तिं भग्नां हनूमता।प्रहृष्टा वानरगणा विनेदुर्जलदा इव ।। ६.७०.४० ।।
transliteration: tāṁ dṛṣṭvā ghorasaṅkāśāṁ śaktiṁ bhagnāṁ hanūmatā।prahṛṣṭā vānaragaṇā vinedurjaladā iva ।। 6.70.40 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the dreadful form of shattered javelin, all Vanaras rejoiced and thundered like rain clouds.
